issues.on_page: Long-Term Compensated Absences, Less Current Obligations 189,527
issues.issue: The rules give accrued liabilities for compensated absences due soon. This is the noncurrent portion, so other liabilities may fit better.
This is a third-party payor settlement receivable (Medicare/Medicaid), so receivables could also apply.
The page doesn't say where the grants come from. They may be government grants (federal grants or intergovernmental/state aid). The extractor already marked it for review.
